# French human-recorded fixture

`en-us-hello.ogg`: English “hello”, recorded by Dvortygirl on 13 August 2005, released into the public domain by its author. Downloaded unchanged from [Wikimedia Commons](https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:En-us-hello.ogg), [original file](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/5/52/En-us-hello.ogg). Used as a non-French recognition control, not pronunciation calibration.

`fr-bonjour.ogg`: “bonjour”, spoken by Vion Nicolas, Paris, France; Shtooka Project, 2006. Downloaded unchanged from [Wikimedia Commons](https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Fr-bonjour.ogg), original audio [file](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/b/bc/Fr-bonjour.ogg). Licensed [Creative Commons Attribution 2.0 France](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/2.0/fr/). Used for recognition testing, not score calibration or a claim about learner pronunciation.
